name: Subset Teaching Dimension of Addressing
proof: Each target has a private positive address coordinate, which teaches it with one ordinary example. For $n\ge2$, all ordinary minimum samples consequently have size one, and no labeled singleton sample can teach two different targets. At the next subset-teaching step these singleton families remain unchanged: an empty sample is contained in every target's family and cannot identify just one. Hence the process is fixed at value one. For $n=1$, the empty sample teaches the sole target and STD is zero.
